2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned Addl. Standing Counsel for the State.
Perused the records.
3.

This is an application under Section 438, Cr.P.C. filed by the Petitioner for anticipatory bail,
involving offence punishable under Section 420 of I.P.C. in G.R. Case No.1469 of 2024 of the Court of learned S.D.J.M., Kendrapara arising out of Marsaghai P.S. Case No.142 of 2024.
4.
Learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that the entire allegation is against the principal accused, namely, Umesh Swain, who has been arrested.
He further contended that the present petitioner is the wife of the principal accused and she has no way connected with the present crime.
5. Learned counsel for the State on the other hand objected to the release of the Petitioner on pre-arrest bail on the ground of seriousness allegations against the present petitioner.

6. Considering the seriousness of the allegation, gravity of the offence and the facts of the case,
although I am not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the Petitioner, however it is observed that, in the event the Petitioner surrenders and moves for bail before the learned court in seisin over the matter within a period of three weeks from today, she shall be released on bail on such terms and
